title: Nerf Breach Effect
description: Halve the effect of the Breach enchantment.
body:
# Purpose
The purpose of this datapack is to reduce the effects of the breach enchantment.

**This datapack works on existing maces.**
# Instructions:
1. Put the datapack in the datapacks folder
2. Enable the datapack by running /datapack enable "file/Nerf_Breach_Effect"
3. Restart the world/server

[Want to limit the maximum level to 2 instead?](https://modrinth.com/project/OLtaM1Kv)

Want to remove the mace instead? [No Heavy Core](https://modrinth.com/project/10jJZvyv)
